svg.title: Observe
svg.desc: Command: console, What it does: What the page logged, uncaught errors included. --level, --clear.; Command: network, What it does: Documents, fetch and XHR calls, and every loaded resource, with status, timing and size. --failed, --filter, --clear.; Command: downloads, What it does: Files the page downloaded, saved under ~/Downloads/Umbra/.; Command: cookies [domain], What it does: Cookie names, domains and expiry dates. Never values.
